rejected.why: 画面に無い文字を根拠にした（照合 0/5）例: ['Weekly Product Sync', '3 participants', 'Waiting for a decision…', 'Stop recording']

weaknesses.what: The black floating toolbar at the top reads as a separate overlay window rather than part of the same card/surface as the meeting panel below it.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the recording controls into the header of the main content card instead of a floating detached pill, so it visually belongs to one surface.

weaknesses.what: Four action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are shown disabled/greyed with no content to act on yet, adding visual weight without utility at this stage.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or fade these controls in until there is enough transcript content to make them meaningful, or replace with a single subtle 'available once discussion starts' hint.

weaknesses.what: There is no indication of which meeting platform or source this recording is coming from, and 'AI が見ている資料' does not show what material is actually referenced.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small source icon/label (e.g. Zoom/Meet/mic) near the meeting title, and make 'AI が見ている資料' expandable to preview the referenced document(s).

weaknesses.what: There is no visible live waveform or audio-level indicator tied to the microphone, so a first-time user watching an empty transcript at 00:02 cannot easily tell whether audio is truly being captured or the app is frozen.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small live audio-level meter or pulsing waveform next to '聞いています...' that visibly reacts to sound, giving instant proof of capture.

weaknesses.what: Four secondary action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are shown disabled with no data behind them yet, adding visual clutter before they're usable.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or collapse these buttons until the transcript has enough content to act on, or show them in a more minimal/ghost state until then.

weaknesses.what: The floating top control pill (pause/comment/expand/more/stop) is disconnected from the main card below it, making it unclear if it belongs to this meeting window or is a separate system-level overlay.
weaknesses.fix: Visually connect the pill to the card (e.g., a subtle shadow/line linking them, or docking it to the card's top edge) so it reads as one surface.

weaknesses.what: The floating control bar at the top feels visually detached from the main interface—it hovers independently rather than appearing as part of the same surface
weaknesses.fix: Either anchor the control bar to the main window edge, or integrate play/pause into the main interface panel itself

weaknesses.what: Large empty panels (transcription, translation, captions) occupy significant space while showing placeholder text. Meeting details (decisions, actions) also show waiting states
weaknesses.fix: Condense empty states or use progressive disclosure—show these panels only when they have content

weaknesses.what: No visual confirmation that audio is being captured beyond the timer. No waveform, levels, or active recording indicator to verify the system is actually recording
weaknesses.fix: Add a subtle waveform or audio level indicator in the recording status area

weaknesses.what: The 'waiting' messages ('待っています') are vague—unclear whether the app is waiting for speech, processing, or something else
weaknesses.fix: Use more specific language: 'No speech detected yet' or 'Waiting for meeting to start' would be clearer

weaknesses.what: The bottom link 'AI is listening to materials' appears orphaned and unclear in its relationship to the main recording task
weaknesses.fix: Either remove this link, clarify its purpose with better context, or integrate it into the main flow more clearly

weaknesses.what: The interface is purely functional with no engaging elements. Heavy reliance on waiting states makes the experience feel passive
weaknesses.fix: Add micro-interactions (animate the listening indicator), provide encouraging feedback as the AI processes audio, or show live transcription preview as words arrive
